clips.title: The story
paras: At the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, Elder Obsidian appears for the Lunar Festival. The ancestral earthen spirit greets travelers among the graves claimed by the Forsaken, offering ancient wisdom and blessings.

Elder Obsidian greets travelers at the Sepulcher during the Lunar Festival. His earthen spirit brings the ancient heritage of Azeroth to Silverpine Forest. The surrounding crypts are held by the Forsaken, and feral worgen menace the forest. Yet Obsidian welcomes wayfarers of every allegiance in peace, offering a Coin of Ancestry and ancient blessings to those who seek his wisdom.
